changes.t: New solicitations were posted Aug 17, 2026: NSF 26-521 (Materials, which includes condensed matter), 26-522 (Astronomy) and 26-523 (Physics). Proposals are accepted anytime, and only some programs post target dates.
Under NSF 26-521, starting Oct 1 each year, a person can be PI or co-PI on only one proposal per fiscal year across all eight materials programs.
MRI, CSSI and the AI Institutes are waiting for new solicitations. MPS-Ascend, WoU-MMA and Mid-scale RI-2 are archived, and PIF has no open topic.

University grants in HEP, NP and BES go through the SC Open Call. The FY2027 call (DE-FOA-0003665) was posted Sep 30, 2026. Nuclear physics applications are due Nov 16, 2026, and the next HEP comparative review takes applications by Sep 2, 2027.

Since Sep 25, 2025, NIH accepts at most 6 applications per PI per calendar year, and from January 2026 institutes no longer use paylines. For due dates from Oct 12, 2027, NIH will merge most individual K awards into four parent notices; the K99/R00 and K22 become the KT1/R00 Career Transition to Research Independence Award.
AFOSR replaced its broad announcement with a new rolling one (FA9550-26-S-0001). The FY2027 MURI and DURIP competitions are posted on grants.gov.
ATP, ADAP, FINESST and the guest-investigator programs are waiting on it.

The President's FY2027 request cuts NSF by 55% (MPS by 67%) and the DOE Office of Science by 13%. A continuing resolution (P.L. 119-103) funds agencies through Dec 11, 2026, largely at FY2026 rates, and full-year appropriations are still pending.

items.t: GRFP (Oct 23), DOE CSGF (Jan 7) and Hertz (Oct 30). All three require US citizenship or permanent residency. Hertz takes PhD students who will be in their first or second year in fall 2027.
HHMI Gilliam Oct 27, Soros for New Americans Oct 29, NDSEG Oct 30, DOE SCGSR Nov 4, NIH F31 Dec 8 and NNSA SSGF Jan 5.
applying for postdocs should use the Postdocs tab.

items.b: External fellowships and the Yale stipend.
items.t: Under the GSAS combined-award policy, an external stipend fellowship replaces the Yale stipend, and Yale may supplement up to the department stipend plus $4,000. Confirm how Physics applies it with the DGS.
ORNL and the Neutrino Theory Network are due Oct 16, and LBNL Chamberlain Oct 18.
Pappalardo and Miller nominee applications are due Oct 9. NSF AAPF is due Oct 15 and is limited to US citizens and permanent residents.
mostly fall between Oct 28 and Nov 16, including Hubble, Flatiron, ITC, CIERA, KITP, IQIM, Burke and IAS.
NIH K99/R00 is due Oct 12 and F32 Dec 8. HHMI Hanna Gray is due Dec 15. BWF CASI is for physicists moving into biology.
NIST NRC postdocs (Feb 1) and the Intelligence Community postdocs require US citizenship. Hubble, CERN Theory and most prize fellowships don't. Use the eligibility filter above.

pd.title: For postdocs and final-year PhD students

items.t: the 2027 pre-proposals are due Oct 8 at noon PT (3 pm ET), and invited full proposals are due in early February 2027. Awards are $1.35M over 5 years for experimentalists first tenured within the past 5 years.

IAS School of Natural Sciences is due Nov 15 and the Aspen summer program Jan 15. Guggenheim and Fulbright closed Sep 15. Fulbright's next competition is expected to open around Feb 2027, and Guggenheim usually opens in the summer and closes in mid-September.

The W.M. Keck Foundation application is due Dec 7 (limited submission; Yale runs an internal round first). The Simons Collaborations LOI is due Oct 29. FY2027 MURI white papers (optional) are due Nov 20 and full proposals Apr 9, 2027. Simons Targeted Grants take LOIs anytime.

FY2027 DURIP is due Nov 6. NSF MRI is waiting for a new solicitation. The NIH S10 notices (PAR-27-022 and PAR-27-021) have one receipt date a year, and this year's dates have passed (Jul 27 for SIG, Sep 25 for SIS); the 2027 dates are not posted yet.
is next due Jul 28, 2027, on the same date for every directorate. Sloan's 2027 cycle closed Sep 15, and the next opens around July 2027.

items.b: Defense early-career awards are due soon.
items.t: The AFOSR YIP white paper is due Oct 9 (full proposal Dec 4) and ONR YIP Oct 30. AFOSR requires a PhD on or after Apr 1, 2019 and ONR a PhD on or after Jan 1, 2019; both are limited to US citizens, nationals and permanent residents. FY2027 DURIP equipment proposals are due Nov 6.
hasn't posted an FY2027 call. The FY2026 round had a pre-application in March and a full application in June.

NIH R01 is next due Nov 5 for resubmissions and Feb 5, 2027 for new applications, and the next NIGMS MIRA deadline for early-stage investigators is Feb 3, 2027. NIH now accepts at most 6 applications per PI per year.
Sloan, Packard, Cottrell, Beckman and DOE Early Career are for untenured faculty. Moore EPI is for faculty tenured within the past 5 years.
Goldwater's Yale deadline is Nov 10 at 1 pm, through the Student Grants Database, and the national deadline is Jan 29.
DOE SULI is due Jan 6, NIST SURF around the end of January, Amgen Scholars Feb 1 (Yale is a host) and NASA OSTEM Mar 1. Most REU sites close mid-January to early February.
NSF funded fewer REU sites after the 2025 cuts, and some sites did not run. Confirm each site is running in 2027.
can apply for GRFP (Oct 23), Hertz (Oct 30) and DOE CSGF (Jan 7).
